name: Facebook Filter
description: A text-format filter that converts Facebook #hashtags in content into links to facebook.com/hashtag pages.
project_description: Facebook Filter ships a single text-format filter plugin (id fb_filter, "Facebook filter") that scans content at display time and turns Facebook-style #hashtags into anchor tags pointing at https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/<tag>. It has one setting controlling whether those links open in a new tab. The module depends only on core's Filter system, provides no routes, permissions, services or Drush commands, and leaves the stored content unchanged (it is a display-time TYPE_TRANSFORM_IRREVERSIBLE filter).
